title_en: Kneel to greet or see off
detail_zh: 对方出门或到家时以约定的姿势迎接
detail_en: A set posture when they leave or return home

detail_zh: 固定时间发一句问候或状态
detail_en: A short greeting or status message at set times

detail_zh: 在约定的场合使用先生/主人等称呼
detail_en: Sir, Master, Ma'am — used at agreed moments

detail_zh: 咖啡、洗漱、衣物准备等固定服务
detail_en: Coffee made their way, clothes laid out, a bath run

detail_zh: 对方检查完成情况并给出评价
detail_en: Being looked over and told what was seen

detail_zh: 出门前拍照/告知时间
detail_en: A photo and the time, sent before leaving

detail_zh: 到家后告知平安到达
detail_en: A message confirming safe return

detail_zh: 对方每天早上指定当日家务
detail_en: Chores assigned each morning

title_zh: 照对方指定的方式做事
detail_zh: 不是效率最高的做法，而是被要求的做法
detail_en: Not the efficient way — the way they asked for

detail_zh: 必须做/禁止做/需请示，写清楚而非默认
detail_en: Required, forbidden, needs permission — written, not assumed

detail_zh: 吃东西、就寝、外出等一件事先问过
detail_en: Eating, bedtime, going out — one thing asked first

detail_zh: 未经许可不得自我满足
detail_en: No release without permission

title_en: Confessing a missed or broken rule
detail_zh: 违规后主动说明，不等对方发现
detail_en: Owning up before being caught

title_zh: 做不到时必须说明原因
title_en: Explaining when a task can't be done
detail_zh: 而不是默默跳过
detail_en: Instead of silently skipping it

detail_zh: 绝不做的事，双方各自列出
detail_en: Things that are simply off the table, named by each of you

detail_zh: 视情况而定、需要额外沟通的事
detail_en: Maybe, only under some conditions — needs more talk

title_zh: 定期重新确认规矩还成立
title_en: Revisiting whether an agreement still holds
detail_zh: 同意不是签一次就永久有效
detail_en: Consent is a subscription, not a signature

detail_zh: 手、拍子等造成的痛感
detail_en: Hand, paddle, or similar — negotiated intensity

detail_zh: 冰、蜡等温度类感官刺激
detail_en: Ice, wax, or similar sensation

detail_zh: 羽毛、刷子等触觉刺激
detail_en: Feathers, brushes, varied textures

detail_zh: 蒙眼或耳塞等
detail_en: Blindfold, earplugs, or similar

detail_zh: 由对方决定是否/何时允许
detail_en: The other decides whether and when

detail_zh: 绳、手铐等
detail_en: Rope, cuffs, or similar

detail_zh: 需要练习和安全知识
detail_en: Needs practice and safety awareness

detail_zh: 较长时间的固定
detail_en: Longer-duration restraint

detail_zh: 由对方保管钥匙/密码
detail_en: The other holds the key or code

detail_zh: 私下或特定场合使用
detail_en: Used privately or in agreed contexts

detail_zh: 轻度、事先谈过边界
detail_en: Light teasing, boundaries discussed first

detail_zh: 仅限私下的两人朋友圈或极小范围
detail_en: Only among a very small trusted circle

detail_zh: 对方用固定的话肯定你
detail_en: A fixed phrase the other uses to affirm you

detail_zh: 对方指定当日/在家穿着
detail_en: What to wear today or at home, specified by the other

detail_zh: 只穿清单内的衣物
detail_en: Only wear what's on the list

detail_zh: 日用项圈、手环等
detail_en: A day collar, bracelet, or similar

detail_zh: 对方要求的仪容标准
detail_en: A grooming standard the other sets

detail_zh: 出门前拍照给对方看
detail_en: A photo sent before leaving the house

detail_zh: 违规后追加的家务
detail_en: Added chores after a rule is broken

detail_zh: 书面反省
detail_en: A written reflection

detail_zh: 暂停某个平时的待遇
detail_en: A usual privilege paused for a while

detail_zh: 限时的姿势惩罚
detail_en: A timed posture as consequence

detail_zh: 需要事先谈好强度与工具
detail_en: Intensity and implement negotiated beforehand

detail_zh: 很多关系只靠肯定推进
detail_en: Many dynamics run entirely on positive reinforcement

title_zh: 惩罚需说明理由，不自动触发
title_en: Punishment must be explained, never automatic
detail_zh: 由人决定并说明，而非系统自动
detail_en: A person decides and explains it — never the system

detail_zh: 具体地说出做得好的地方
detail_en: Naming specifically what was done well

detail_zh: 对方兑现一个小心愿
detail_en: The other grants a small wish

detail_zh: 不被打扰的相处时间
detail_en: Undistracted time together

title_en: A rule loosened for a while
detail_zh: 由对方决定暂时放宽
detail_en: The other decides to ease a standing rule

detail_zh: 攒够分数换取自定义奖励
detail_en: Earn points toward a custom reward list

detail_zh: 特定情境下的角色互动
detail_en: A scripted context for interacting differently

title_en: An outing with an agreed rule in place
detail_zh: 例如出门佩戴象征物但不公开
detail_en: e.g. wearing a symbol discreetly while out

detail_zh: 提前谈好内容与安全词
detail_en: Content and safeword agreed in advance

detail_zh: 在外仍保留某些仪式
detail_en: Some rituals kept even away from home

detail_zh: 每天告知吃了什么、喝了多少水
detail_en: What was eaten, how much water was drunk

detail_zh: 睡前告知一天的情况
detail_en: A short account of the day before sleep

title_zh: D 不在家时自动暂停
detail_zh: 对方出差/不在时相关任务暂停
detail_en: Related tasks pause while the D is away

detail_zh: 一方提议，另一方接受或调整
detail_en: One side proposes, the other accepts or reorders

title_en: Leaving a note on a calendar day
detail_zh: 求饶或提议惩罚可写在当天
detail_en: A plea for mercy or a proposed consequence, on that day

title_en: A feelings log after a task
detail_zh: 完成任务后写下当时的感受
detail_en: Writing down how it felt, after the fact
